title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: Final Settlement Amount, Rounding and the Recorded Measure
content:
Under `Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims`, the figure written on an approval, and the liability measure recorded beside it, are fixed as follows.

## Final amount

- Where the tier's annual aggregate limit is above 0.00, the final amount is the settlement before any aggregate or the aggregate still available on the cover, whichever is lower.
- Where the tier's annual aggregate limit is 0.00, the settlement before any aggregate is the final amount without reduction.

## Rounding

The final amount is rounded to the cent. Three intermediate figures are rounded to the cent as they are formed: the Hague-Visby limit, the declared value share, and the invoice value of the packages affected. Every other figure, such as the loss basis or the remainder after a deductible, is carried unrounded until the final amount.

## Measure recorded with the approval

- **Aggregate limit**, whenever the aggregate still available is lower than the settlement before any aggregate, so that the amount is reduced to what remains of the aggregate.
- Where the aggregate did not reduce the amount, the measure is the one that bound:
  - **package limitation** or **weight limitation**: the Hague-Visby limit held the amount down, and the one named is the limit, per package or per kilogram, whose amount was the higher;
  - **declared value**: the amount was held to the declared value share;
  - **cover limit**: the amount was held to the per-container cover cap;
  - **proven loss**: all remaining cases, a proven loss that was itself held to the invoice value of the packages affected among them.

## Worked examples (hypothetical figures)

| Settlement before any aggregate (USD) | What produced it | Aggregate limit of the tier | Aggregate still available (USD) | Final amount (USD) | Measure recorded |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 4500.00 | proven loss | above 0.00 | 3000.00 | 3000.00 | aggregate limit |
| 50000.00 | per-container cap | above 0.00 | 120000.00 | 50000.00 | cover limit |
| 1258.027 | loss basis less deductible | above 0.00 | 90000.00 | 1258.03 | proven loss |
| 10708.05 | Hague-Visby limit, package amount higher | 0.00 | not applicable | 10708.05 | package limitation |
